lines.en: Neither one of us gets particularly inebriated tonight, but I still walk Imani home because I am a good person who does good things.
lines.zh: 今晚我们俩谁都没有特别醉,但我还是送 Imani 回了家——因为我是个做好事的好人。

lines.en: Just sometimes, the good things I do disguise themselves as bad ones.
lines.zh: 只是有时候,我做的那些好事,会伪装成坏事的样子。

lines.en: But not in the fact that I’ve necessarily done something wrong. Just that I’ve done something that’s led to some sort of unfortunate consequence.
lines.zh: 但这不是说我一定做错了什么。只是我做的一件事,导致了某种不幸的后果。

lines.en: Like a good friend doubting herself or the...many people I’ve made inadvertently miserable by virtue of just existing in the way I have to.
lines.zh: 比如一位好朋友开始自我怀疑,或者……由于我不得不以我的方式存在,而无意间被弄得 miserable 的许多人。

lines.en: As an icon of all things tempting.
lines.zh: 作为一切诱惑的化身。

lines.en: An unworthy god among a congregation of blindly loyal servants.
lines.zh: 作为一群盲目忠诚的仆从之中,不配的神明。

lines.en: Or a lecherous shepherd guiding a herd of prized sheep.
lines.zh: 或者作为一群珍稀绵羊之上,好色的牧羊人。

lines.en: I doubt Imani sees me as any of those specifically-
lines.zh: 我不怀疑 Imani 并不 specifically 把我看作其中任何一种——

lines.en: But when I’m face to face with her in a manner in which I know she wants to invite me inside, I can’t help but open myself up to these self-aggrandizing approximations.
lines.zh: 可当她与我面对面、而我清楚她想请我进屋时,我忍不住任由这些自我膨胀的近似描述涌上心头。

lines.en: : Sorry that nobody else was able to make it, Senpai. I...honestly had no idea that was going to happen. If I did, I wouldn’t have invited you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉其他人都没能来,Senpai。我……说实话完全没想到会这样。早知道的话,我就不会请你来了。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Well...you know, like...it’s just not a thing we normally do alone.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你知道,就是……我们平时不会单独做这种事。

lines.en: : I’ve been to your house alone before and I think, if anything, that would be even weirder. Going out to drink is completely normal.
lines.zh: : 我以前单独去过你家,而且我觉得真要论怪,那才更怪。出去喝一杯完全正常。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah. You’re right. I don’t know what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 是……是。你说得对。我都不知道自己在说什么。

lines.en: : I just didn’t want you to assume that this was some kind of date or anything since you’re already, like...you know...dating a superstar. And I kind of suck by comparison.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你以为这是某种约会什么的,毕竟你已经,那个……在和一位巨星约会了。而相比之下,我确实逊毙了。

lines.en: : In the least self-loathing way possible, though. Like, it’s less that I actually suck and more that just...I’m not a famous idol. Or something.
lines.zh: : 当然是以最不自厌的方式说的。就是说,与其说我真的逊,不如说……我不是什么著名偶像。或者什么的。

lines.en: : Imani, I’m not seeing Niki because she’s famous. I’m seeing her because she gets me. In a way that I don’t think anyone else really does yet.
lines.zh: : Imani,我和 Niki 在一起,不是因为她是名人。是因为她懂我。以一种我目前认为没有第二个人真正做到的方式。

lines.en: : Well, it’s...not like you make it easy, Senpai. So kudos to her for that. Girl really did put the work in, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那……也不是因为你把门槛抬得低,Senpai。所以这点得夸她。那姑娘确实下了苦功,我猜。

lines.en: : She did. And a lot of it. But it’s exactly that that makes me not worth whatever you’re beating yourself up over right now.
lines.zh: : 她下了。还下了很多。而恰恰因此,你才不值得为此刻这样折磨自己的事费神。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I’m not beating myself up over anything, Senpai. You’re just imagining things.
lines.zh: : 你说什么呢?我没有为任何事折磨自己,Senpai。你在臆想。

lines.en: : If I’m just imagining things, that means everyone is imagining things. You know that tonight wasn’t just an accident. Everyone bailed on purpose so the two of us would be alone.
lines.zh: : 如果我在臆想,那就是所有人都在臆想。你知道今晚绝不只是巧合。所有人都是故意放鸽子,好让我们俩独处。

lines.en: : And if you want to keep pretending like that’s not the case and forcing yourself to not say anything that might make things weird between us, don’t. That’s not the kind of relationship I-
lines.zh: : 而如果你还想继续假装不是这样、强迫自己不说任何可能让我们之间变怪的话——别。那不是我想要的那种关——

lines.en: : Do you want to come inside?
lines.zh: : 你想进来吗?

lines.en: : Never mind. Forget I said that.
lines.zh: : 没事。就当我没说。

lines.en: : I’ve been inside before, Imani.
lines.zh: : 我以前进过你的屋子,Imani。

lines.en: : Not...like this, you haven’t. This is different.
lines.zh: : 不……不是以这种「进法」。这次不一样。

lines.en: : Imani...can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : Imani……我能问你一件事吗?

lines.en: : Sure...yeah.
lines.zh: : 当然……嗯。

lines.en: : Do you think there’s something wrong with the way things are between us right now?
lines.zh: : 你觉得,我们现在之间的状态有什么不对劲吗?

lines.en: : What? No. That’s not it at all.
lines.zh: : 什么?没有。完全没有。

lines.en: : Then...are you just not worried about that dynamic changing or something?
lines.zh: : 那么……你就不担心那种平衡被打破什么的吗?

lines.en: : I’m just trying to figure out why I’m the one who’s worried about ruining our relationship when I’m essentially always of the mindset that sex makes everything better.
lines.zh: : 我只是想弄明白,为什么担心毁掉我们关系的会是我——毕竟我 essentially 永远认为,性会让一切更好。

lines.en: : I don’t...I don’t want to ruin our relationship, Senpai. You’re my best friend. Wakana too, of course. But I see you way more than her and the mere...thought of that gets me out of bed some mornings.
lines.zh: : 我不……我不想毁掉我们的关系,Senpai。你是我最好的朋友。当然 Wakana 也是。只是我见你的次数比她多得多,而仅仅是……想到失去你,有些早晨我都能因此起床。

lines.en: : And, to be totally honest, I am worried about ruining that. I’ve been worried about it for a while. Why else would I have been so hesitant to have this discussion?
lines.zh: : 而且,完全坦白地说,我确实在担心毁掉这一切。担心有一阵子了。不然你以为我为什么迟迟不肯开启这场对话?

lines.en: : The jig is up. I like you. We both know it. And there’s no reason to hide it anymore, so...I’m not going to bother trying. But if you don’t like me-
lines.zh: : 把戏拆穿了。我喜欢你。我们彼此心知肚明。也没有理由再藏着掖着,所以……我不打算再费这个劲。但如果你不喜欢我——

lines.en: : I do like you. Isn’t that obvious?
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你。这不是明摆着的吗?

lines.en: : What?! No! I could have sworn you were signposting the exact opposite of that all night!
lines.zh: : 什么?!不!我敢发誓你一整晚都在给完全相反的方向打信号!

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s fair. I guess I’m kind of hard to understand at times.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这倒公平。我猜我确实有时候挺难懂的。

lines.en: : You think?! Change your facial expression every once in a while or something! Leaving your feelings all up to guesswork can mess with a person’s head!
lines.zh: : 你说呢?!偶尔换换你的表情好不好!把所有情绪都留给别人猜,是会把人逼疯的!

lines.en: : Yeah, but so can feelings as a whole.
lines.zh: : 是,但「情绪」这东西本身也会。

lines.en: : Don’t change the topic! Tell me more about how and why you like me!
lines.zh: : 别转移话题!多讲讲你是怎么、为什么喜欢我的!

lines.en: : You’re funny. And weird — but in a way that’s more entertaining than off-putting.
lines.zh: : 你有趣。而且怪——但怪得娱乐性强过劝退。

lines.en: : You do virtually all of my work for me and, despite complaining about it, I know you kind of enjoy it. Plus, the way you pester me all the time is actually a little heartwarming now that I’ve gotten used to it.
lines.zh: : 你几乎替我做完了我的全部工作,而且尽管嘴上抱怨,我知道你其实乐在其中。加上你总在我耳边纠缠,如今习惯了,竟有点暖心。

lines.en: : Or at least it would be heartwarming if I actually had a...well, heart.
lines.zh: : 至少,要是我真有一颗……心的话,应该会暖心。

lines.en: : You keep my life at a good level of chaotic, but counteract it by helping me organize things I’d never bother with on my own. And all of the girls seem to love you as well.
lines.zh: : 你把我的人生维持在一个恰到好处的混乱水平,又通过帮我整理那些我自己绝不会碰的事来抵消它。而且女孩们似乎也都喜欢你。

lines.en: : I think you’re smart and driven and I respect that you don’t normally take shit from me. And that you’re not afraid to call me out on things I don’t apply myself to.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你聪明、有干劲,而且我尊重你平时不惯着我的态度。还有你敢当面点出我不肯用功的地方。

lines.en: : You and Niki are a lot alike in that regard. She’s just a little more brutally honest and less fun than you.
lines.zh: : 你和 Niki 在这方面很像。她只是比你狠一点点、无聊一点点。

lines.en: : Also, you’re extremely attractive and I masturbate to fantasies of you almost regularly.
lines.zh: : 还有,你极其有魅力,而我几乎定期会对着关于你的幻想自慰。

lines.en: : And I probably could have left that part out if I wanted, but I felt like this semi-rant was missing an element that did justice to your physical traits and that was just the first thing I thought of.
lines.zh: : 而且这一段我要是想省,本来可以省——但我觉得这场半长篇大论缺了一个配得上你外形条件的元素,而那是我想到的第一件事。

lines.en: : But Senpai, if you really feel that way about me, what is there to gain from just...keeping things the way they are?
lines.zh: : 可是 Senpai,如果你真对我有这种感觉,那只是……维持现状,又能图什么?

lines.en: : It’s not about gaining anything. It’s about not losing something.
lines.zh: : 不是图什么。是不想失去什么。

lines.en: : I understand that I’m in a unique position when I say this, but I can have almost anyone as a partner if I want.
lines.zh: : 我知道,由我来说这话很特殊,但只要我愿意,我几乎可以和任何人在一起。

lines.en: : But there aren’t many people I can have as friends.
lines.zh: : 可是我能拥有的朋友,不多。

lines.en: : Let alone people like you, who I just...can’t really seem to find any issues with.
lines.zh: : 更别说你这样的人——一个我……似乎实在挑不出毛病的人。

lines.en: : Which is why I want to keep things the way they are.
lines.zh: : 正因如此,我才想维持现状。

lines.en: : I want to keep silently looking forward to seeing you in school without worrying about betraying you or hurting you which I know I would if we were together. I can’t resist that.
lines.zh: : 我想继续默默期待着在学校见到你,而不用担心背叛你或伤害你——我很清楚,如果我们在一起,我一定会。我抗拒不了那个。

lines.en: : Keeping you at arm’s length is for the benefit of both of us in the long run as there’s just way too much to lose if we take the opposite route. And I don’t want to lose you.
lines.zh: : 把你保持在一臂之遥,长远来看对我们两个都好——因为走另一条路,要失去的实在太多。而我不想失去你。

lines.en: : Did any of that make sense?
lines.zh: : 这些话有哪句讲通了吗?

lines.en: : Yeah. This is just the first time I’ve ever been friend-zoned, so I’m not really sure how to respond.
lines.zh: : 讲通了。这只是我第一次被发好友卡,所以我真不知道该怎么回应。

lines.en: : It’s also the first time I’ve ever friend-zoned anyone. So you can take solace in the fact that you’re not alone right now. And that you were also a first for me in a very roundabout, non-ideal way.
lines.zh: : 这也是我第一次给别人发好友卡。所以你可以稍感安慰:你现在并不孤单。而且以一种非常迂回、非常不理想的方式,你对我而言也是「第一次」。

lines.en: : How long do you plan on just looking at me without saying anything?
lines.zh: : 你打算这样一言不发地看我多久?

lines.en: : Until I can figure out a way to ask you if you want to come inside and have friend-sex with me.
lines.zh: : 直到我想到办法,问你要不要进来和我进行「朋友间做爱」。

lines.en: : Ew. You too?
lines.zh: : 恶。你也来这套?

lines.en: : Y-Yumi! Hi! Whaaaaat are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : Y-Yumi!嗨!你来这里干————什么?!

lines.en: : Getting sick. And questioning what the fuck I must have done this time to make both of my teachers come after me this late at night.
lines.zh: : 来恶心。顺便质疑我这次到底干了什么,能让我的两个老师大半夜地追杀到我家楼下。

lines.en: : Nothing! Nothing at all! In fact...I was just talking about how we should be giving you extra credit since you’re such an amazing girl who would never repeat anything she just heard to anyone!
lines.zh: : 什么都没干!真的什么都没有!其实……我们刚才还在说,该给你加学分——像你这么棒的女孩,绝不会把刚才听到的任何话转述给任何人!

lines.en: : This another trap? Cause I already fell for the poem thing and I ain’t about to let a third teacher walk all over me.
lines.zh: : 这又是陷阱吗?诗歌那事我已经栽过一次了,我可不打算让第三个老师骑到我头上。

lines.en: : Nonsense! I would never! In fact, why don’t all three of us take a load off in my apartment so none of my neighbors assume I’m speaking inappropriately to teenagers?!
lines.zh: : 胡说!我永远不会!其实,我们仨不如都进我公寓歇会儿,免得我的邻居们以为我在和未成年人说不合适的话?!

lines.en: : Imani, I don’t think Yumi wants to have friend-sex with us.
lines.zh: : Imani,我不觉得 Yumi 想和我们进行「朋友间做爱」。

lines.en: : For the first time in my life, I actually agree with him.
lines.zh: : 有生以来第一次,我同意他的观点。

lines.en: : Haha! Funny joke, you two! Come on in! The extra credit’s in here!
lines.zh: : 哈哈!你们俩真会开玩笑!进来吧!学分在里面!

lines.en: : That’d be more convincing if it didn’t sound like somebody was tryin’ to lure me into a van with candy.
lines.zh: : 这话要不是听着像有人想用糖果把小孩骗上面包车,会更有说服力一点。

lines.en: : Visiting your mom again?
lines.zh: : 又去看你妈妈?

lines.en: : She ain’t home. I just wanted something to eat.
lines.zh: : 她不在家。我只是想吃点东西。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to come inside with us?
lines.zh: : 你确定不和我们一块儿进去?

lines.en: : That a joke? I ain’t ever been more sure of anything in my life.
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧?我这辈子没对任何事这么确定过。

lines.en: : Please come inside, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 请进来吧,Yumi。

lines.en: : What? Why? All that’ll do is prevent you from addin’ one more notch to your belt. Assumin’ it ain’t already frayed to shit from all the other ones, that is.
lines.zh: : 什么?为什么?那只会让你腰带上的刻痕少一条。前提是它还没被其他刻痕磨成烂绳。

lines.en: : Please. As a favor to me.
lines.zh: : 拜托。算帮我个忙。

lines.en: : You actually...don’t want to go in there. Do you?
lines.zh: : 你其实……并不想进去。对吧?

lines.en: : It’ll only take a little while. Think of it as payment for the phone you’ve had all these years that is still, somehow, not paid off.
lines.zh: : 只要一小会儿。就当是还你这些年用着的那部手机——那笔钱, somehow 到现在都还没还清。

lines.en: : Throw in another IC card and you’ve got a deal. I already used up the one the goth teacher gave me.
lines.zh: : 再加一张交通卡,成交。哥特老师给的那张我已经用完了。

lines.en: : Done.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Hah...should’ve asked for more. That was too easy.
lines.zh: : 哈……早该多要一点的。也太容易了。

lines.en: Yumi resignedly walks into Imani’s apartment and I dig deeper into the depths of my mind to figure out what’s going on with me as it’s...unlike anything I’ve felt before.
lines.zh: Yumi 神情黯然地走进 Imani 的公寓,而我向脑海更深处挖掘,想弄明白我到底怎么了——因为这种感觉……与我经历过的一切都不同。

lines.en: By all accounts, Imani is one of the most morally correct people for me to have a physical relationship with.
lines.zh: 无论从哪个角度看,Imani 都是和我发展肉体关系道德上最正当的人选之一。

lines.en: Our ages aren’t all that far apart...she’s not seeing anyone....we both like each other. And, apart from the same romantic consequences that would befall any relationship I enter, no one would get hurt.
lines.zh: 我们的年龄差距并不算大……她没有在跟任何人交往……我们互相喜欢。而且,除了任何一段恋情都会遭遇的那些寻常后果之外,没有人会受伤。

lines.en: Is it because of the moral correctness that I feel so wrong about this?
lines.zh: : 是不是因为道德上太正当了,我才觉得这一切如此不对?

lines.en: Is it because there is no daughter, son, or distant relative that I’d be leading on in the process of fucking her?
lines.zh: : 是不是因为上她的过程中,没有被我在感情上拖下水的什么女儿、儿子或远房亲戚?

lines.en: Or am I really just that desperate for someone to love me in a way different from the others?
lines.zh: : 又或者,我真的只是太渴望有人以一种不同于其他人的方式爱我?

lines.en: And if so...why?
lines.zh: : 如果是的话……为什么?

lines.en: I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我不明白。

lines.en: I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我不明白。

lines.en: : So...we good? You’re not gonna, like...tweet about this or anything?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们两清了?你不会,那个……把这事发到推特上什么的吧?

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Yumi’s in the same social media boat as me. IE: she doesn’t give a shit.
lines.zh: : 我相当确定,Yumi 和我坐在同一条社交媒体的船上。也就是说:她根本不在乎。

lines.en: : Yo, why the fuck does your place look all nice-ish while Yuki’s straight up sucks? Ain’t no cigarette smell or anything.
lines.zh: : 哟,凭什么你家看着还挺像样,而 Yuki 家 straight up 烂透了?连烟味都没有什么的。

lines.en: : That’s...probably on account of me not smoking. But yeah! Your mom’s my neighbor! You should come visit more often or...or something.
lines.zh: : 那……多半是因为我不抽烟。不过对!你妈是我邻居!你可以多来串门,或者……什么的。

lines.en: : Chill. I ain’t gonna tell anybody shit. And  you don’t gotta worry about bein’ all nice to me to keep me from stickin’ my hands where they don’t belong.
lines.zh: : 淡定。我谁都不会告诉。你也不用担心要对我和和气气,免得我把手伸到不该伸的地方。

lines.en: : Oh, thank God. Because having two secrets of mine under your belt is far too much power for me to just ignore.
lines.zh: : 哦,谢天谢地。因为我有两个秘密握在你手里,这份权力大到我无法忽视。

lines.en: : Two? What’s the first one?
lines.zh: : 两个?第一个是什么?

lines.en: : Nothing you need to be concerned about! Or will be concerned about any time soon if our current rate of progress is at all indicative of the future!
lines.zh: : 你不用操心的事!或者说,以我们目前的发展速度推测未来,近期内你都不用操心的事!

lines.en: : Instead, why don’t we talk about you?! What’s new in the life of Yumi Yamaguchi? You...beat up anyone good lately? Or...
lines.zh: : 不如聊聊你吧?!山口由美的生活中有什么新鲜事?你……最近揍了什么值得一揍的人吗?或者……

lines.en: : You say that as if I just go around pickin’ fights with whoever the fuck I want.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像我整天想揍谁就揍谁似的。

lines.en: : To be fair, I have significantly less experience with you than literally everyone else in the class on account of how frequently absent you are...So please forgive me if I’ve mischaracterized you.
lines.zh: : 平心而论,相比班上 literally 其他所有人,我和你的交集少得可怜——毕竟你缺勤太频繁了……所以如果我对你的评价有失偏颇,请多包涵。

lines.en: : Ehh. You ain’t too far off, I guess. But I haven’t laid a finger on anybody since the Nodoka shit went down. Kinda just tryin’ to lay low at this point.
lines.zh: : 呃。你猜得也不算太离谱。但自从 Nodoka 那档子事之后,我没再碰过任何人。眼下多少是在低调行事。

lines.en: : And how’s your mom? Is she doing well?
lines.zh: : 那你妈妈呢?她还好吗?

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. She can get hit by a car for all I care.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。被车撞了都与我无关。

lines.en: : Jesus, girl. You ain’t gotta talk about your momma like that. That shit ain’t cool.
lines.zh: : 天,姑娘。你不能那样说你妈。那样不厚道。

lines.en: : Cooler than abandoning your daughter so you can go suck dick for heroin or whatever it was she did all those years away. I ain’t bitter, though. Shit happens.
lines.zh: : 比抛下女儿、跑出去为了海洛因卖身——或者她离家那几年干的所有事——厚道多了。不过我不苦大仇深。世事如此。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Yumi. You sound pretty bitter. But I guess I might be too if those...circumstances are at all accurate.
lines.zh: : 我不知道,Yumi。你听着挺苦大仇深的。但如果那些……情况属实,换成我大概也一样。

lines.en: : There’s gotta be something-
lines.zh: : 总得有点——

lines.en: : Don’t touch me.
lines.zh: : 别碰我。

lines.en: : There’s gotta be something, though! Something you’re looking forward to, I mean.
lines.zh: : 总得有点什么吧!我是说,值得期待的东西!

lines.en: : Like, yeah. Maybe the Dorm Wars weren’t a personal highlight for you on account of how you were a pawn in the second floor’s chess game...but Halloween’s right around the corner!
lines.zh: : 就是说,好。也许宿舍大战对你来说算不上什么个人高光——毕竟你只是二楼棋局里的一颗棋子……但万圣节就在眼前了!

lines.en: : Are you looking forward to that at all?
lines.zh: : 那个你期待吗?

lines.en: : Why are you asking me so many questions when I already told you you don’t have to do this to get me to keep your secrets?
lines.zh: : 我都说了你不用做这些也能保住你的秘密,你为什么还要问我这么多问题?

lines.en: : I’m just trying to get to know you better! And also, Senpai and I are in a weird spot right now that we can totally ignore thanks to your presence and participation in this conversation.
lines.zh: : 我只是想更了解你!而且,Senpai 和我现在正处在一个微妙的阶段——多亏了你的到场和参与这场对话,我们完全可以把它忽略过去。

lines.en: : Halloween sucks. Christmas sucks. New Year's sucks. All of the holidays suck and I ain’t lookin’ forward to anything. That do the trick? Are your weird, adult problems solved now?
lines.zh: : 万圣节烂透了。圣诞节烂透了。新年烂透了。所有的节日都烂透了,我什么都不期待。这样行了吗?你们奇怪的、成人的问题都解决了吗?

lines.en: : Do you just hate fun? Is that what your deal is?
lines.zh: : 你就是讨厌快乐吗?你的问题就是这个?

lines.en: : Part of it, probably.
lines.zh: : 有一部分吧,大概。

lines.en: : She left out the part where Halloween is also her birthday. So I imagine she hates that one the most of all.
lines.zh: : 她漏掉的部分是,万圣节也是她的生日。所以我想,她最恨的就是那一个。

lines.en: : Would it kill you to just, like...not remember things about me? Cause that’d be doin’ me a huge favor, asshat.
lines.zh: : 你能不能就,那个……别记住关于我的事?那可是在帮我的大忙,混球。

lines.en: : Wait, is it really? How did I not know that?
lines.zh: : 等等,真的吗?我怎么不知道?

lines.en: : Nobody is supposed to know that because-
lines.zh: : 本来就不该有人知道,因为——

lines.en: : We should do something to celebrate. We could get an extra cake for the Halloween party or something.
lines.zh: : 我们该做点什么庆祝一下。可以给万圣节派对多订一个蛋糕什么的。

lines.en: : Because that always happens. I don’t want to fucking celebrate my stupid ass birthday. It’s just a day. And the further away I am from the center of attention, the better.
lines.zh: : 因为那种事总会发生。我才不想庆祝我那个蠢透了生日。那就是个日子而已。而且我离所有人的视线中心越远越好。

lines.en: : Well damn, girl. Tell us how you really feel.
lines.zh: : 好家伙,姑娘。把真心话全说出来吧。

lines.en: : Listen, can I leave now? I’m still hungry and I really didn’t wanna waste away my night in a creepy apartment with two creepy adults.
lines.zh: : 听着,我能走了吗?我还饿着,而且我今晚真不想在古怪公寓里陪两个古怪成人虚度。

lines.en: : Senpai being creepy, I understand. Me being creepy? That’s just wrong. I’m the lovable student teacher that everybody gets along with. I’m not allowed to be creepy.
lines.zh: : Senpai 古怪,我理解。我古怪?那就太离谱了。我可是人见人爱的实习老师。我没资格古怪。

lines.en: : Nah, you’re pretty fuckin’ creepy. Just not nearly as bad as the guy next to you.
lines.zh: : 不,你相当他妈古怪。只是远没有你旁边这位恶劣。

lines.en: : Would you mind if I came with you? I left something in Yuki’s apartment last time I went over there.
lines.zh: : 介意我跟你一起走吗?上次去 Yuki 家,我落了点东西。

lines.en: : What is it? Just fuckin’ tell me and I’ll-
lines.zh: : 是什么?直说呀,我——

lines.en: : Wait. Yes. That thing. I remember now.
lines.zh: : 等等。对。那件东西。我想起来了。

lines.en: : You may come with me.
lines.zh: : 你可以跟我一起走。

lines.en: : Thanks. I should probably start heading home now anyway, so...
lines.zh: : 谢了。反正我也该回家了,所以……

lines.en: : You can just tell me if you don’t want to be here, Senpai. You don’t have to lie about it.
lines.zh: : 你要是不想待在这,直接跟我说就行,Senpai。没必要撒谎。

lines.en: : Imani-
lines.zh: : Imani——

lines.en: : Actually, don’t even worry about it. I’ll see you in school tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 其实,别放在心上。明天学校见。

lines.en: : Actually, don’t even worry about it. I’ll see you in school on Monday.
lines.zh: : 其实,别放在心上。周一学校见。

lines.en: : I had fun tonight. Sorry nobody else was able to turn up. Even if it was a...calculated absence on all of their behalves.
lines.zh: : 今晚很开心。抱歉其他人都没能来。尽管那是一场……对所有人而言精心策划的缺席。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure it doesn’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 我会保证这种事不再发生。

lines.en: : You don’t-
lines.zh: : 你不用——

lines.en: : Just...go get your “thing.” And have a safe trip home. I’ll be back to normal the next time you see me. Promise.
lines.zh: : 去拿你的「东西」吧。回家路上小心。下次你见到我时,我就恢复正常了。保证。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Have a good night, Imani.
lines.zh: : 晚安,Imani。

lines.en: I leave the room with Yumi.
lines.zh: 我和 Yumi 一起离开了房间。

lines.en: There are no parting words or anything like that.
lines.zh: 没有临别的话,什么都没有。

lines.en: But before she opens the door and heads into her mother’s apartment, she makes eye contact with me.
lines.zh: 但在她打开门、走进母亲的公寓之前,她与我有了短暂的对视。

lines.en: Her expression is complicated...and I can’t really tell what it means.
lines.zh: 她的表情很复杂……我读不出那是什么意思。

lines.en: But if I had to take a guess-
lines.zh: 但如果非要我猜——

lines.en: I think it was pity.
lines.zh: 我觉得那是怜悯。

lines.en: When I get home, I look in the mirror.
lines.zh: 回到家,我照了照镜子。

lines.en: And I confirm that it was.
lines.zh: 然后我证实,那就是怜悯。

lines.en: Then I...
lines.zh: 接着我……

lines.en: I just go to sleep.
lines.zh: 我直接去睡觉了。

lines.en: That’s all I do.
lines.zh: 我能做的仅此而已。

lines.en: Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
lines.zh: Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!

lines.en: Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!
lines.zh: Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]!
